findings.reason: §7, §2 and §10 each fence their suite delta while §8, the most invasive change of the three, does not, so a builder either lands a red suite in a file it was not granted or silently ignores it.
findings.text: §8's done-when carries no suite-delta clause even though its change redefines the registered, live and released fields for a foreign registration, which every one of the six readers it lists consumes, and the landed test asserting the old lock judgement (tests/test_a_snapshot_is_published_for_every_host.py, 325 lines, cited in the §4 landings) is outside §8's declared write paths (follower_registration.py, crew_follow_commands.py, tests/test_a_follower_on_another_node_renews_a_lease.py)

findings.reason: the section's brief should name the gate and the file whose assertions move with the new state, as §10 does for its own shared reader.
findings.text: §9 adds a fourth state to freshness whose docstring fixes the vocabulary at "fresh or one of three fixed reasons" (reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:369-371) and declares no suite-delta, while the obligation-snapshot tests that assert that vocabulary (tests/test_obligations_snapshot_is_published.py) are outside §9's write paths

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — renew_producer_lease (reckon/crew/runs.py:1764), producer_lease_seconds (runs.py:1702), the _renew_producer_lease wait pass (crew_follow_commands.py:1578/1624), seat_names_a_live_foreign_producer (watch_unit.py:143), watch_state (watch_unit.py:161), freshness (obligation_snapshot.py:369), not_fresh_line (coordinator_obligations.py:729), _newest_stream_in_motion (recovery_liveness.py:194), _orientation_write_of_a_run_in_motion (recovery_liveness.py:152), process_gone (recovery_classification.py:409) and session_follower_released (dispatch_watch.py:708) all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §8 and §9 each change a shared reader and declare no suite-delta, and §8's change breaks a landed test that sits outside its write paths.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §9's post-merge confirmation path (~/.config/reckon/crew/obligations/reckon/) and the "logged under the run directory" controls for §8/§9/§10 are durable crew-home paths, not a scratchpad or node-local temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the three sections introduce no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag in a symbol, file or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §8's premise is the code's: _follower_liveness does derive registered from the node-local flock (follower_registration.py:501) and released from it (follower_registration.py:606), and the snapshot sweep does read through that single reader (runs.py:2294 filters list_followers, which calls _follower_liveness at follower_registration.py:634), so correcting it reaches the sweep the done-when names; §8's lease window is the producer's own (producer_lease_seconds, runs.py:1702); §9's cited defect is exact (obligation_snapshot.py:376 returns NO_PRODUCER for a missing document before consulting the seat) and both freshness call sites (coordinator_obligations.py:875 and :1108) route to not_fresh_line, which already receives project; §10's quoted defect is the code's line (recovery_classification.py:409) and its unreadable arm is the process_gone-gated one at recovery_classification.py:811.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §8 (lease judgement), §9 (hook line for a missing snapshot), §10 (unknown liveness in the hoisted verdict) each name one deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §9's dependency on §8 is declared as gate g-sheinr-1 (data-section="s9", data-gated-sections="s9", required evidence a-seat-held-elsewhere-is-not-restarted#s8), matching the followup f-sheinr-003 ordering, and §10's reuse of §7's landed helper introduces no undeclared edge.
